items.html:
Loa Nou is a right-arm medium-fast bowler who began playing cricket in a "Liklik" village competition in 1998. He is part of Papua New Guinea's Under-19 squad for the World Cup in 2008 and he helped his team qualify by taking four wickets against Vanuatu in the qualifiers. He also performed memorably in the South Pacific Games in 2007 where he took three wickets in each of PNG's victories over Tonga and Fiji.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
